2.2.9.title: VOD Search Category Routing, Playback Stall Fix & Full App Restart
2.2.9.releaseNotes:
• Live TV Search Bar Focus: Cleaned up Live TV search bar on focus by removing the redundant 'OK TO SEARCH' badge for a cleaner, modern look
• Preview Space Channel Location: Removed category badges from channel list items in search results; category location is now cleanly presented strictly in the preview info space below the live player
• VOD Search Category Navigation: Selecting any Movie or Series search result navigates directly to that item's parent category, automatically scrolling and focusing the title within its category as if navigated manually
• Continuous VOD Playback Fix: Resolved mid-stream pausing and stalling on titles like 'The Drop: A Snowfall Saga' (Hulu/FX/Fox/ABC) and high-bitrate series by eliminating socket read timeouts, adding Matroska MKV detection, and enabling dynamic hardware AudioCapabilities passthrough
• Guaranteed Full System Reboot: Replaced immediate process exit with scheduled AlarmManager PendingIntent execution and affinity termination for a guaranteed 100% full OS-level app restart
• Strict Quad-Portal Lock: Locked strictly to the 4 approved server portals (vpn.uhdp.top, tv.wd.uhdp.top, vpn.uhd4.top, tv.wd.uhd4.top) with zero references or fallbacks to unauthorized domains
• Password Visibility Toggle: Added eye toggle button to view entered passwords in Settings and authentication dialogs
• Streamlined Navigation: Retired the temporary Now Playing module to deliver a lightning-fast, rock-solid core entertainment experience

2.2.6.title: Fullscreen Fix, Live TV Category D-Pad, VOD Covers & Launch Defaults
2.2.6.releaseNotes:
• Fullscreen Black Screen Fixed: Entering fullscreen no longer shows a black frame — stream resumes immediately on the new surface without requiring channel changes
• Live TV Category D-Pad Auto-Update: Moving the remote D-pad up/down through categories now instantly updates the channel list without requiring a select press
• Now Playing → Live TV Playback: Selecting a live channel from Now Playing immediately begins playing it in the preview pane — no extra button press needed
• VOD Covers in Now Playing: All movie and series poster images in Now Playing now load reliably with retry logic and fallback resolution
• VOD Time Bar During Operations: Progress bar and timestamps appear whenever you interact with the player controls
• Default to Live TV: App now opens directly on Live TV on every launch

2.2.5.title: Remote Control Single-Press Selection & Live TV Category Stability
2.2.5.releaseNotes:
• Single-Press Selection: Fixed remote control select/OK double-press requirement across all cards and buttons by removing redundant focusable modifiers, eliminating focus shifts, and capturing KeyDown events
• Full Remote & Gamepad Coverage: Added KEYCODE_BUTTON_A and KEYCODE_BUTTON_SELECT support alongside D-pad Center, Enter, and Numpad Enter
• Live TV Category Stability: Fixed unintended category jumping when selecting a channel to play by removing clearFocus and category onFocusChanged auto-selection
• VOD Focus Protection: Eliminated clearFocus calls in Movies and Series to ensure stable remote D-pad focus during playback launch and dialog interactions

2.2.4.title: Real-Time Credential Vetting (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), Direct Auth & Module Unlock
2.2.4.releaseNotes:
• Real-Time Credential Vetting: Vets credentials upon entry directly against the 4 authorized portals in parallel, showing bright green ACTIVE or bright red INACTIVE badge with instant module auto-unlock
• Direct Username & Password Auth: Replaced phone number entry with clean direct Username and Password fields; removed all phone activation systems, formatters, and lookups
• Quad-Portal Authorization: Strictly locked to the 4 approved portals (vpn.uhdp.top, tv.wd.uhdp.top, vpn.uhd4.top, tv.wd.uhd4.top); purged legacy portal5458 and kstv
• Module Content Loading & Mutex Fix: Eliminated Kotlin Mutex re-entrancy deadlock in CatalogManager, restoring instant channel and catalog loading across Now, Live TV, Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts
• Raw Query Parameters & Auth Parsing: Reverted urlEncode escaping to standard raw query format and enhanced auth/status extraction to reliably validate accounts
• Now Page Deep Navigation: Selecting any card in Now Playing directly routes to Live TV, Movies, Series, or Podcasts with targeted category selection and item auto-focus
• VOD Forced-Pause Elimination: Resolved playback stall on newly launched VOD items with strict buffering play guards, initial hidden HUD, and 1000ms key release isolation
• Show Password Toggle: Added eye visibility toggle in Settings and login dialogs to view entered credentials
• Deep System Reboot Restart: System reboot flushes all media caches and seamlessly restarts the application process

2.2.3.title: Category Badges in Search, VOD Instant Playback Fix & Key-Up Collision Guard
2.2.3.releaseNotes:
• Category Identification in Search: Search results across Live TV, Movies, and Series now display distinct category badge tags identifying exactly which category each result belongs to
• VOD Instant Playback (No Forced Pause): Eliminated remote key-up collision where pressing D-Pad Center/Enter on search cards inadvertently paused the video upon launch
• Dynamic Credentials & Failover Sync: Ensured VOD and Live TV stream requests dynamically query active authenticated credentials and failover portals at launch time
• IME & Focus Clearing: Search bar focus and soft keyboard automatically dismiss upon selecting a card for uninterrupted playback
• Quad-Portal Failover Sequence: Continuous direct connection across 4 prioritized server portals with zero fallbacks to dummy presets

2.2.2.title: Quad-Portal Direct Failover, Validated Xtream Server Auth, Now Page & Universal Access Lockdown
2.2.2.releaseNotes:
• Quad-Portal Failover Sequence: Guaranteed direct server connection across 4 prioritized server portals with zero fallbacks to dummy local presets
• Validated Server Auth: Full support for active Xtream credentials with instant authorization and cache synchronization on live streams and VOD
• Server Portal Privacy: Internalized portal management and sanitized UI to ensure server addresses remain secure
• Now Page Live Feeds: Fixed empty 'On Air Right Now' and 'Trending Premieres & Blockbusters' by populating live EPG progress and active VOD streams directly from authenticated server portals
• Universal Access Lockdown: Uniform 'Access Restricted' security guard across Live TV, Movies, Series, Now, Music, and Podcasts when credentials are not entered
• Surf-Saver Smart Mashup: Cross-category personalized programming row blending watch history, favorites, and watchlist genres

2.2.1.title: Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus, Live TV Malformed Container Fix & VOD Decoder Auto-Recovery
2.2.1.releaseNotes:
• Instant Search Bar Focus: Search bar immediately highlights the moment TV remote D-pad moves over it before pressing Select, featuring 1.04x scale expansion, 3dp amber border, glowing halo shadow, and 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' gold badge
• Live TV Container Fix: Resolved 'ERROR_CODE_PARSING_CONTAINER_MALFORMED' by removing strict AUD detection from MPEG-TS extractors, adding SCTE-35 splice stream tolerance, and rejecting deceptive HTML error pages in the media stream
• VOD Decoder Auto-Recovery & 4K Crash Protection: Fixed decoding failed reconnect stalls by auto-advancing past corrupt keyframes and refreshing hardware codec surfaces; reduced backBuffer to 20s to eliminate 4K out-of-memory crashes

2.2.0.title: Restored Functional VOD Player Configuration & YouTube / Search Focus Enhancements
2.2.0.releaseNotes:
• Restored VOD Configuration: Fully reverted VOD media engine to the proven functional configuration (prioritize time over size, extension renderers prefer, standard 30s buffer) to guarantee reliable movie & series streaming
• YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience: Preserved fix eliminating global pauseTimers freeze and added instant channel RSS fallbacks so feeds never stall
• Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus: Preserved distinct TV remote focus highlight with 1.03x scale expansion, amber halo glow, and 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' cue

2.1.9.title: 4K VOD Crash Fix, YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience, and Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus
2.1.9.releaseNotes:
• 4K VOD Stability: Eliminated 4K movie crashes and sudden app closure by disabling excessive backBuffer retention, removing prioritizeTimeOverSizeThresholds, dynamically querying HDMI audio capabilities, and enabling largeHeap
• YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience: Resolved subsequent playback freezes by eliminating global WebView pauseTimers, adding genre memory caching, and introducing guaranteed instant official RSS feed fallbacks
• Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus: Unmistakable visual cues when moving over the search bar via D-pad before selection: animated scale expansion (1.03x), glowing amber shadow, and high-contrast 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' badge

2.1.8.title: Restored Music & Podcasts Video Playback, Native YouTube Player & Stability Fixes
2.1.8.releaseNotes:
• Restored Music & Podcasts Playback: Reverted to the rock-solid v2.1.5 player architecture with native WebView integration and privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie embedding
• Fixed Video Playback Lockup: Removed artificial desktop Windows UA and hardware layer override that caused black screens and bot verification blocks on YouTube
• Reliable Media Transitions: Full media engine reinitialization during System Reboot with clean socket pool tear-down
• Animated Search Focus: Distinct 3dp border glow and SEARCH label pill on remote D-pad focus

2.1.7.title: Media Engine Reinitialization, YouTube Feeds Fix & Animated Search Focus
2.1.7.releaseNotes:

• YouTube, Music & Podcasts Recovery: Prevented premature cancellation of in-flight catalog and feed requests during reboot
• High-Contrast Search Focus: Smooth animated color and 3dp border expansion on D-pad focus with visible SEARCH label pill

2.1.6.title: Music Video Playback Fix, TV Dinner System Reboot, Module-Wide History & Rated-R Filtering
2.1.6.releaseNotes:

• TV Dinner System Reboot: Added streaming system reset button in Settings to flush playback engines, socket pools, and caches without touching credentials
• Module-Wide History: Added 🕒 History to Movies, Series, Music, and Podcasts with selective multi-section clear dialog in Settings
• Rated R Adult Filter: Automatically hides 'Rated R' movie categories and titles when the Adult Content Filter is active
• Closed Captions: Updated Settings Closed Captions toggle and remote CC shortcuts to apply directly to Music and Podcasts

2.1.5.title: VOD Playback Stabilization, Seamless Transitions, Start-at-Beginning & Podcasts Navigation

• Seamless Media Transitions: Switch between any media (Live TV, Movies, Series, Podcasts, Music) with clean state reset and zero need to restart app
• VOD Start-at-Beginning: Movies and Series strictly start from 0:00 unless 'Resume' is explicitly chosen in the dialog
• Podcasts Remote Back Navigation: Pressing Back on remote when viewing a channel's episode list returns directly to previous search or category view

• Unblocked Channel Navigation: Guaranteed instant Right navigation from categories to channels under all conditions without unmounting list

• Verified Credential Gating: Music and Podcasts are strictly gated behind verified active credentials

2.1.3.title: Live TV Category Navigation Fix & Priority VOD Poster Loading

• Instant Channel Focus: Restores channel list position and focuses active playing channel when returning to its category
